name: m4-lazydepth-paired

variantDescriptions.eager: lubDepth computed before solving and merging, as in base
variantDescriptions.lazy: lubDepth computed only when solve lubs/glbs two or more bounds, or mergePrefixAndArgs merges prefixes or arguments that differ

description: Lazy lub depth (`claude/typeref-bench-lazydepth`, with a bench-only `-Ylazy-depth` flag: `claude/typeref-bench-lazydepth-flag`) off vs on, alternating by iteration within each fork. Eager `lubDepth` in `solvedTypes`' callers was 369M cycles/op inclusive in base's typer profile; the laptop spike (m5-lazydepth-kperf) measured -2.9% cycles. Typer only, scala corpus, 4 forks of 40 + 60 single shots, M4.
